body: A couple of things to sort before merge, all inline.

comments.body: CR: in OrderExportController, when there's no `status` the query filters on `status IS NULL`, so the export comes back empty instead of returning every order. Could the filter apply only when the param is present, like `->when($request->filled('status'), fn ($q) => $q->where('status', $request->input('status')))`?
FFT: the export loop in OrderExportController loads `customer` once per order, so `Order::with('customer')` might be worth it to load them all in one query.
FFT: `send()` in InvoiceMailer is synchronous, so the request waits on SMTP and a mail failure fails the request. Could `queue()` move it off the request path?
